min_mps.description: Friction floor (m/s) that actually moves the robot; a clamp on the tiers below, not a tier.

max_mps.description: Upper bound (m/s) on any tier; the accessors clamp, so an unreachable value is inert.

creep_mps.description: Contact zone, the heading limiter's floor, and the stuck-escape nudge (m/s).

slow_mps.description: Near obstacles (0.10-0.25 m clearance) and the risk != SAFE cap. Was slow_frac = 0.75.

medium_mps.description: Moderate clearance (0.25-0.50 m) and the blind corridor-follow before direction settles (m/s).

fast_mps.description: Open track: >0.50 m clearance, and every heading error below the 57 deg crawl threshold. At the ceiling today. Was fast_frac = 1.0.

open_slow_mps.description: Optional open slow mps override in m/s; absent means the base tier applies.

open_medium_mps.description: Optional open medium mps override in m/s; absent means the base tier applies.

open_fast_mps.description: Optional open fast mps override in m/s; absent means the base tier applies.

open_max_mps.description: Optional open max mps override in m/s; absent means the base tier applies.

obstacles_slow_mps.description: Optional obstacles slow mps override in m/s; absent means the base tier applies.

obstacles_medium_mps.description: Optional obstacles medium mps override in m/s; absent means the base tier applies.

obstacles_fast_mps.description: Optional obstacles fast mps override in m/s; absent means the base tier applies.

obstacles_max_mps.description: Optional obstacles max mps override in m/s; absent means the base tier applies.

corner_mps.description: Optional corner mps override in m/s; absent means the base tier applies.
